items.title: Uber (UBER) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower As Analysts Weigh AV Spending And Delivery Hero
items.summary: Uber Technologies has seen its fair value estimate adjusted from about US$104.48 to about US$101.50 per share, which signals a more measured stance on upside from current levels. Most analysts are fine tuning targets within ranges such as US$90 to US$100 and US$110 to US$115, reflecting mixed but generally constructive views rather than a reset of the overall story. items.title: Uber Faces €825 Million Dutch Fine Over Driver Suspensions
items.summary: Uber Technologies Inc. has been fined €825 million ($963 million) by Dutch authorities for using automated systems to suspend driver accounts, in what is the second-largest penalty under the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation.
